adjudication.basis: The primary study records real lay users exploring MusicPinta RDF entities and relates path properties to knowledge and experience outcomes. Proposed exploration strategies derive from observed paths; the report does not test a deployed recommendation algorithm against a control.

report_level_evaluation.design: Observed task-driven exploration and pre/post knowledge elicitation; associations between path parameters and outcomes analyzed.
report_level_evaluation.measures: Accurate concepts named before/after: remember, categorize, compare; Modified NASA-TLX-like experience questionnaire; Path generality/direction/density/anchors/dead ends
report_level_evaluation.results: Not reported; limits: One music domain, short exploration, self-report and path-outcome association; no causal proof of guidance superiority or validation across domains. Modified NASA-TLX is not assumed identical to standard workload scoring.; The 12-person instrument-familiarity survey is preparatory, not another 12 users in the 32-person main study; overlap is not established. Four survey allocations are not four independent 32-person cohorts.

One music domain, short exploration, self-report and path-outcome association; no causal proof of guidance superiority or validation across domains.
